entries.event: Board state at record as_of timestamp: incident_state 'hypothesis_blocked'. Board summary: 'intg-prod-a1 is experiencing recurring nightly memory exhaustion and near-total CPU saturation from setroubleshootd (99.7% CPU since 2026-03-02), which correlates with batch transfer latency and console slowness. The cause of the SELinux AVC denial storm driving setroubleshootd has not been established; audit log evidence is outstanding and convergence is blocked.' convergence_allowed: false. Five blocking evidence items outstanding. No mitigation attempts recorded.
entries.source: Board state
entries.falsifying_test: Board state record showing a different incident_state or convergence_allowed value at this timestamp.

entries.event: Hypothesis 1 (confidence: supported): 'setroubleshootd is consuming ~100% CPU in response to a high-volume stream of SELinux AVC denials that began on 2026-03-02, and this CPU saturation is the proximate cause of batch transfer latency and console slowness on intg-prod-a1.' Falsifying test per board: 'Inspect /var/log/audit/audit.log for AVC denial counts per hour from 2026-03-02 onward; if denial volume is low or absent, setroubleshootd CPU consumption has a different cause not yet identified.'
entries.source: Board state: hypotheses[0]
entries.falsifying_test: Board state showing a different confidence level or falsifying test for this hypothesis.

entries.event: Hypothesis 2 (confidence: plausible): 'The installation of endpoint-compliance-agent 7.4.2-27 (CHG-88104) on 2026-02-22 triggered novel SELinux AVC denials that activated setroubleshootd on 2026-03-02, initiating the CPU and memory exhaustion pattern.' Falsifying test per board: 'Inspect /var/log/audit/audit.log for AVC denials from 2026-02-22 through 2026-03-02; if no denials are attributable to the endpoint-compliance-agent source domain, this hypothesis is falsified. Additionally, confirm whether the agent was active and consuming memory between 2026-02-22 and 2026-03-01; flat memory during that period weakens the correlation.'
entries.source: Board state: hypotheses[1]
entries.falsifying_test: Board state showing a different confidence level or falsifying test for this hypothesis.

entries.event: Hypothesis 3 (confidence: plausible): 'The integration service JVM has a memory leak contributing to the rising sawtooth memory pattern, with the JVM's resident set growing during each batch cycle and partially recovering, compounding the memory exhaustion alongside setroubleshootd.' Falsifying test per board: 'Collect a JVM heap dump from pid 3489339; if heap occupancy is stable and within historical norms, the JVM is not contributing to the memory growth pattern. Swap metrics would also clarify whether the JVM is being paged out during exhaustion events.'
entries.source: Board state: hypotheses[2]
entries.falsifying_test: Board state showing a different confidence level or falsifying test for this hypothesis.

entries.event: Hypothesis 4 (confidence: supported): 'The recurring nightly memory exhaustion events (P-4100 through P-4112) have been auto-closing without acknowledgement for 15 days, masking a progressive degradation that has now manifested as user-visible latency.' Falsifying test per board: 'Compare batch transfer completion times and console response times on days when problems were open versus closed; if performance is identical in both states, the auto-closing events are not causing user-visible impact.'
entries.source: Board state: hypotheses[3]
